title: Spelling, Phones & Emails
description: Spell names and exchange a practice phone number and email address clearly.
objectives: Spell names and exchange a practice phone number and email address clearly.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to spell names and exchange a practice phone number and email address clearly. The central language is alphabet spelling and digit-by-digit numbers. It belongs to the practical context of numbers, time & dates. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: How do you spell your last name?
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the spelling, phones & emails exchange.

Use this question or response to keep the spelling, phones & emails exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “How do you spell your last name?” and “My practice email is maya@example.com.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: alphabet spelling and digit-by-digit numbers.
